1.name: Operator
1.label: Operator · Tier I
1.blurb: Owns one job, start to finish.

2.name: Deputy
2.label: Deputy · Tier II
2.blurb: Owns an entire function, with judgment and escalation.

volume.label: Under 50 a week
volume.hint: a small team, or a job that happens a few times a day

volume.label: 50 to 200 a week
volume.hint: the usual answer for an established small business

integrations.name: CRM
integrations.eg: HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Zoho, Go High Level

integrations.name: Phone system
integrations.eg: RingCentral, Dialpad, Twilio, a plain mobile number

integrations.name: Inventory / stock
integrations.eg: Cin7, Katana, Zoho Inventory, a spreadsheet

10dlc.short: US carrier registration required — weeks, not days
10dlc.long: Texting your customers from a US business number requires A2P 10DLC registration with the carriers. Part of it is a manual review that no supplier can hurry, so budget weeks rather than days. Everything else in your agent goes live on schedule; SMS switches on when the registration clears, at no extra cost.

meta.short: Meta business verification required — usually days
meta.long: WhatsApp Business messaging needs Meta to verify the business. It is normally days rather than weeks, but it is outside our control and so is not promised inside the delivery window.

capabilities.name: Email triage
capabilities.blurb: Reads every incoming message, works out what it is and how urgent it is, and sorts it.
capabilities.accept: Given 50 real messages from the last month, classification matches the owner's own sorting on at least 45.

capabilities.name: Reply drafting
capabilities.blurb: Writes the reply, in your voice, using your prices and policies rather than generic filler.
capabilities.accept: Ten drafts across the five most common message types are sendable with no edit or a trivial one.

capabilities.name: Routing and assignment
capabilities.blurb: Sends each message to the right person or queue with the context already attached.
capabilities.accept: Every routing rule in the job description fires correctly against a replayed week.

capabilities.name: Response deadlines
capabilities.blurb: Tracks how long anything has been waiting and escalates before a customer has to chase.
capabilities.accept: A message left unanswered past the agreed threshold produces an escalation, every time.

capabilities.name: Conversation memory
capabilities.blurb: Holds a multi-message conversation without losing the thread or repeating itself.
capabilities.accept: A five-turn exchange stays coherent and never re-asks something already answered.

capabilities.name: Backlog clearance
capabilities.blurb: Works through the existing pile once, so you start from zero instead of from four hundred.
capabilities.accept: The historic backlog is classified and dispositioned, with a written summary of what was found.

capabilities.name: Web chat
capabilities.blurb: A chat widget on your site that the agent actually staffs.
capabilities.accept: A visitor conversation completes end to end on a staging page without a human.

capabilities.name: Slack or Teams
capabilities.blurb: It works where your team already talks, and can be asked things directly.
capabilities.accept: The agent responds in-channel and its actions appear in the audit log.

capabilities.name: SMS
capabilities.blurb: Texts your customers from a business number and acts on what they text back.
capabilities.accept: A round-trip text conversation completes, and opt-outs are honoured immediately and permanently.

capabilities.name: WhatsApp
capabilities.blurb: The same conversation on WhatsApp, for the customers who live there.
capabilities.accept: A round-trip WhatsApp conversation completes and opt-outs are honoured.

capabilities.name: Answers the phone
capabilities.blurb: Picks up in a real voice, understands the call, and takes the actions that come out of it.
capabilities.accept: Ten test calls covering the agreed scenarios are handled without a human, including one it must escalate.

capabilities.name: Places calls
capabilities.blurb: Rings customers to confirm, remind, chase or follow up, and records the outcome.
capabilities.accept: Outbound calls place, record an outcome against the right record, and respect calling-hour rules.

capabilities.name: Lead capture
capabilities.blurb: Catches every enquiry from every source and puts it in one place, with nothing lost.
capabilities.accept: Enquiries from each configured source appear as records within a minute, with no duplicates.

capabilities.name: Lead enrichment
capabilities.blurb: Fills in what the enquiry didn't tell you, from public sources, before anyone reads it.
capabilities.accept: Enrichment runs on every new lead and is marked clearly as inferred rather than stated.

capabilities.name: Lead qualification
capabilities.blurb: Asks the qualifying questions and scores the lead against what a good customer looks like for you.
capabilities.accept: Scoring against 30 historic leads matches the owner's own judgment on at least 25.

capabilities.name: Lead routing
capabilities.blurb: Hot ones to you immediately, the rest handled without you.
capabilities.accept: Every routing branch fires correctly on a replayed set of historic leads.

capabilities.name: Long-game nurture
capabilities.blurb: Keeps in touch with the ones who said not yet, so they come back to you and not a competitor.
capabilities.accept: A not-now lead receives the agreed sequence, and it stops the moment they respond.

capabilities.name: Quote follow-up
capabilities.blurb: Chases every quote until the customer answers one way or the other, then stops.
capabilities.accept: A quote is chased on the agreed schedule, stops instantly on any reply, and records the reason it was lost.

capabilities.name: Outbound sequences
capabilities.blurb: Runs a multi-step outreach sequence to a list you supply, and stops on any reply.
capabilities.accept: Sequences send on schedule, halt on reply, honour suppression, and every send is attributable.

capabilities.name: Booking
capabilities.blurb: Offers real slots that respect travel time and job length, then books them.
capabilities.accept: Offered slots never conflict, never breach buffer rules, and land on the right calendar.

capabilities.name: Reminders and confirmations
capabilities.blurb: Confirms, then reminds at the intervals that actually reduce no-shows.
capabilities.accept: Every booking produces the agreed confirmation and reminder sequence.

capabilities.name: Rescheduling and no-shows
capabilities.blurb: Handles the reschedule conversation without you, and fills a cancellation from the waiting list.
capabilities.accept: A reschedule request completes without a human, and a cancelled slot is offered onward.

capabilities.name: Outbound appointment setting
capabilities.blurb: Works a list and books meetings into the calendar, rather than waiting to be contacted.
capabilities.accept: A worked list produces booked meetings with correct records and honoured opt-outs.

capabilities.name: CRM read and write
capabilities.blurb: Reads and updates your CRM itself, so records are right without anyone typing.
capabilities.accept: Records created and updated by the agent match the field mapping exactly, with no orphan records.

capabilities.name: Interaction logging
capabilities.blurb: Every call, message and outcome logged against the right record, automatically.
capabilities.accept: Every agent interaction appears on the correct record within a minute.

capabilities.name: CRM hygiene
capabilities.blurb: Deduplicates, normalises and fills the gaps, continuously, instead of never.
capabilities.accept: A dry run over the live database reports duplicates and fixes, and no merge happens without approval.

capabilities.name: Pipeline discipline
capabilities.blurb: Nothing sits in a stage forever. It moves work along or tells you why it can't.
capabilities.accept: Stale records are surfaced on the agreed threshold and progressed or escalated.

capabilities.name: Multi-step process
capabilities.blurb: Runs a whole process across several systems, in order, without a person shepherding it.
capabilities.accept: The documented process completes end to end on real data, in the right order, at least three times.

capabilities.name: Exception handling
capabilities.blurb: When something doesn't fit the process, it works it out or escalates — it doesn't just stall.
capabilities.accept: Each exception listed in the job description is either resolved or escalated with the reason attached.

capabilities.name: Operates web apps with no API
capabilities.blurb: Logs into the portal and does the work by hand, the way a person would, when there is no other way in.
capabilities.accept: The task completes on the live portal on three consecutive days, and a UI change produces an alert rather than silent failure.

capabilities.name: Portal data extraction
capabilities.blurb: Pulls what you need out of a system that won't export it.
capabilities.accept: Extracted data matches a hand-checked sample exactly, and a format change raises an alert.

capabilities.name: Watches files and folders
capabilities.blurb: Notices when something lands in a folder or a drive, and acts on it.
capabilities.accept: A file arriving in the watched location triggers the agreed action within the agreed window.

capabilities.name: Your own software
capabilities.blurb: Connects to the in-house system nobody else integrates with.
capabilities.accept: Read and write against the customer's API succeed, with error handling and retries proven.

capabilities.name: Document generation
capabilities.blurb: Produces the quote, contract, invoice or report itself, as a finished PDF.
capabilities.accept: Generated documents match the approved template exactly, with correct figures on ten samples.

capabilities.name: Reads incoming documents
capabilities.blurb: Opens the PDF, the invoice, the form, and pulls out what matters.
capabilities.accept: Extraction from twenty real documents matches a hand-checked result on the agreed fields.

capabilities.name: Payment collection
capabilities.blurb: Sends payment links, takes deposits and issues invoices.
capabilities.accept: A test transaction completes end to end and reconciles against the right record.

capabilities.name: Chases what's unpaid
capabilities.blurb: Reminds before due, on due, and after — escalating tone gradually, stopping the moment it's paid.
capabilities.accept: The dunning sequence runs on schedule and halts within minutes of payment.

capabilities.name: Reconciliation
capabilities.blurb: Matches what came in against what was owed, and flags what doesn't line up.
capabilities.accept: A month of real transactions reconciles, with every discrepancy listed and explained.

capabilities.name: Data collection
capabilities.blurb: Pulls the numbers out of the systems they're trapped in, on a schedule.
capabilities.accept: Scheduled collection runs produce complete datasets, and a failed source raises an alert.

capabilities.name: Analysis and answers
capabilities.blurb: Answers questions about your own numbers, in plain language, with the working shown.
capabilities.accept: Ten questions answered against known data are correct and cite the rows they came from.

capabilities.name: Charts and visualisation
capabilities.blurb: Turns the answer into something you can actually look at.
capabilities.accept: Charts render correctly on desktop and mobile and match the underlying figures.

capabilities.name: Scheduled reports
capabilities.blurb: The Monday morning report writes and sends itself.
capabilities.accept: The report generates and delivers on schedule for two consecutive cycles.

capabilities.name: Threshold alerts
capabilities.blurb: Tells you the moment a number goes somewhere it shouldn't.
capabilities.accept: Each configured threshold fires correctly, and does not fire when it shouldn't.

capabilities.name: Research
capabilities.blurb: Goes and finds out — about a prospect, a competitor, a supplier, a market.
capabilities.accept: Five research briefs are accurate, sourced, and clearly separate fact from inference.

capabilities.name: Answers support questions
capabilities.blurb: Answers from your documentation rather than from the internet, and says so when it doesn't know.
capabilities.accept: Twenty real questions are answered correctly, and an unknown produces an escalation rather than a guess.

capabilities.name: Proactive status updates
capabilities.blurb: Tells the customer where things are before they have to ask.
capabilities.accept: Status updates send at each agreed milestone against a replayed job.

capabilities.name: Ticket handling
capabilities.blurb: Opens, updates, escalates and closes tickets in the system you already use.
capabilities.accept: Full ticket lifecycle completes in the live help desk, with correct priority and ownership.

capabilities.name: Runs the checklist
capabilities.blurb: Takes a new client or new hire through onboarding in order, the same way every time.
capabilities.accept: A full onboarding run completes with every step recorded and nothing skipped.

capabilities.name: Chases what's missing
capabilities.blurb: Collects the documents and details, and keeps asking the humans who owe them.
capabilities.accept: A missing item produces the agreed chase sequence and stops on receipt.

capabilities.name: Knowledge pack
capabilities.blurb: Your prices, policies, documents and SOPs loaded in, so it answers from your business.
capabilities.accept: Twenty questions drawn from the source material are answered from it, with the source cited.

capabilities.name: Approval console
capabilities.blurb: A queue where anything it wants to do waits for a human yes. This is what the Approve level runs on.
capabilities.accept: Actions above the configured threshold queue rather than execute, and approval releases them correctly.

capabilities.name: Reporting dashboard
capabilities.blurb: A live view of what it did, what it recovered, and where it escalated.
capabilities.accept: Dashboard figures reconcile against the audit log for a full week.

capabilities.name: White-label surfaces
capabilities.blurb: Every page and message it touches carries your domain and your branding.
capabilities.accept: No BlvkWare branding appears on any customer-facing surface, and links resolve on the customer's domain.

capabilities.name: Additional language
capabilities.blurb: The same judgment and the same tone, in another language.
capabilities.accept: Ten exchanges in the additional language are accurate and hold the agreed tone.

capabilities.name: Data export and API
capabilities.blurb: Everything it knows, available to your other systems, on demand or on a schedule.
capabilities.accept: Export returns complete, well-formed data and the endpoint is authenticated.

capabilities.name: Staging environment
capabilities.blurb: A safe copy to try changes against before they reach live customers.
capabilities.accept: A change deploys to staging, is exercised, and promotes to live without touching live data first.

capabilities.name: Team training
capabilities.blurb: Ninety minutes, remote, recorded, so your team knows how to work with it and when to overrule it.
capabilities.accept: Session delivered and the recording handed over.

capabilities.name: Answers where my order is
capabilities.blurb: Looks up the real order and the real tracking, and answers the question people ask most.
capabilities.accept: Twenty real order enquiries are answered from the actual order record, and an order it cannot find escalates instead of guessing.

capabilities.name: Watches every shipment
capabilities.blurb: Follows each parcel and spots the ones that have stopped moving before the customer does.
capabilities.accept: A shipment with no movement past the agreed window is flagged, and a delivered one is not.

capabilities.name: Runs returns and exchanges
capabilities.blurb: Takes the return from request to label to refund, in order, without a person shepherding it.
capabilities.accept: A return completes end to end on real data, and anything outside the returns policy is escalated rather than approved.

capabilities.name: Recovers abandoned checkouts
capabilities.blurb: Follows up the carts that were nearly orders, then stops the moment they buy or ask you to.
capabilities.accept: A recovery sequence sends on schedule, stops instantly on purchase or opt-out, and never messages the same cart twice.

capabilities.name: Watches stock before it runs out
capabilities.blurb: Knows what is running down, how fast, and says so while there is still time to order.
capabilities.accept: An item projected to run out inside the agreed lead time raises exactly one alert, and a healthy item raises none.

capabilities.name: Reconciles stock across channels
capabilities.blurb: Compares what each system thinks you have and surfaces every difference rather than picking a winner.
capabilities.accept: A full comparison lists every discrepancy with both figures, and no count is silently overwritten.

capabilities.name: Chases suppliers
capabilities.blurb: Purchase orders nobody confirmed and deliveries that are late, chased on a schedule.
capabilities.accept: An unconfirmed order is chased on the agreed cadence and stops the moment the supplier replies.

capabilities.name: Tells customers where things are
capabilities.blurb: Proactive delivery updates, so the customer hears from you before they have to ask.
capabilities.accept: Each agreed milestone produces one update, and a delivered order stops producing them.

capabilities.name: Claims for lost and damaged
capabilities.blurb: Assembles the evidence and files the carrier claim, which is money most businesses quietly write off.
capabilities.accept: A claim is assembled with every required document, and one missing a document is held rather than filed.

capabilities.name: Asks for the review
capabilities.blurb: Asks after every finished job. Happy customers reach your review page; unhappy ones reach you first.
capabilities.accept: Every customer is asked the same question, a high rating is offered the public review page, a low one alerts the owner within the minute, and nobody is prevented from posting.

capabilities.name: Never misses a renewal
capabilities.blurb: Contracts, subscriptions and retainers, chased before they lapse rather than after.
capabilities.accept: A renewal inside the agreed window is actioned once, and one already renewed is left alone.

capabilities.name: Tracks certificates and licences
capabilities.blurb: Insurance, tickets, licences and accreditations, with the chasing done before they expire.
capabilities.accept: An expiry inside the warning window raises exactly one escalation, and it does not repeat until the record changes.

roles.name: Email Manager
roles.oneLine: The inbox stops being a swamp
roles.problem: Four hundred unread, three people half-responsible, and the important one from Tuesday still buried. It reads everything, sorts it, routes it, and drafts the replies that write themselves.

roles.name: Front Desk
roles.oneLine: All inbound, every channel, one memory
roles.problem: The phone, the texts, the web form, the inbox — one worker owning all of it. A customer who called this morning and texts this afternoon isn't starting over.

roles.name: Support Agent
roles.oneLine: Everything after the sale
roles.problem: The part of the business that generates repeat work and referrals, and the part that always loses the fight for attention against new work. It doesn't lose that fight.

roles.name: Lead Qualifier
roles.oneLine: Only the real ones reach you
roles.problem: Most enquiries aren't worth your time and a few are worth dropping everything for. Telling them apart is a job, and right now it's your job.

roles.name: Appointment Setter
roles.oneLine: The calendar fills itself
roles.problem: Booking, confirming, reminding, rescheduling. The admin around appointments is nearly all of the work, and none of it needs a person.

roles.name: Follow-Up Agent
roles.oneLine: Nothing you quoted goes quiet
roles.problem: You sent the quote on Tuesday. Nobody rejected it — it just got buried. This chases every estimate until the customer actually answers.

roles.name: Outreach Agent
roles.oneLine: The list gets worked, every day
roles.problem: Prospecting is the first thing to fall off the list when work gets busy, which means it fails hardest exactly when there is most to lose.

roles.name: Revenue Deputy
roles.oneLine: Owns the pipeline end to end
roles.problem: From first enquiry to signed job. It moves work through the pipeline, chases what's stalled, and on Friday tells you what it won, what it lost, and why.

roles.name: CRM Operator
roles.oneLine: The CRM stops lying to you
roles.problem: A CRM is only worth what someone puts into it, which is why yours is half empty. This one keeps it true without anybody typing.

roles.name: Workflow Operator
roles.oneLine: The process runs without a shepherd
roles.problem: The multi-step thing that crosses four systems and only works because one person remembers all of it. That person is the bottleneck, and they'd like a holiday.

roles.name: Browser Operator
roles.oneLine: Works the systems that have no way in
roles.problem: The supplier portal, the insurer's site, the council system — the ones with no API and no export, where somebody logs in and copies things by hand. It does that instead.

roles.name: Onboarding Agent
roles.oneLine: The first two weeks, identical every time
roles.problem: New client or new hire, same problem: a checklist that exists in one person's head and gets done differently every time.

roles.name: Collections Agent
roles.oneLine: Invoices that chase themselves
roles.problem: Chasing money is the job everyone hates and therefore the job nobody does. This one has no feelings about it and stays polite through every reminder.

roles.name: Back Office Deputy
roles.oneLine: Quote to invoice to paid to reconciled
roles.problem: The whole money pipeline across whatever tools you already run. It doesn't replace your accounting package; it operates it, which is the part nobody has time for.

roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.oneLine: Answers about your own numbers
roles.problem: The figures exist, spread across five systems, and getting a straight answer out of them takes a day you don't have. Ask it instead.

roles.name: Reporting Agent
roles.oneLine: The Monday report writes itself
roles.problem: Somebody spends half a day a week assembling a report that three people skim. That half-day is recoverable.

roles.name: Research Agent
roles.oneLine: Finds out, before the meeting
roles.problem: Prospect research, competitor moves, supplier checks — all valuable, all skipped, because it's an hour nobody has.

roles.name: Order Desk Agent
roles.oneLine: Nobody has to ask where their order is
roles.problem: Where is my order is the most common question in ecommerce and the least valuable use of anyone time. This one answers it from the real order and the real tracking, in seconds, every time.

roles.name: Returns Agent
roles.oneLine: Returns stop eating the week
roles.problem: A return is six small steps and a judgment call, repeated all day. It is the most labour-intensive thing in an online shop and the least interesting.

roles.name: Ecommerce Deputy
roles.oneLine: Owns everything after the buy button
roles.problem: The whole post-purchase experience - order questions, tracking, exceptions, returns and the review request - owned by one worker with one memory of the customer.

roles.name: Stock Agent
roles.oneLine: You stop finding out too late
roles.problem: Running out is expensive, and finding out from a customer is worse. This watches what is running down, how fast, and says so while there is still time to order.

roles.name: Shipment Agent
roles.oneLine: The stuck parcel finds you first
roles.problem: Most delivery problems are known to the carrier long before they are known to you, and to the customer before either. This closes that gap, and claims for what never arrives.

roles.name: Renewals Agent
roles.oneLine: Nothing lapses quietly
roles.problem: Contracts, retainers, insurance, tickets and licences all expire on a date somebody was supposed to remember. Revenue and compliance leak through the same gap.

modifiers.name: Rush delivery
modifiers.blurb: Half the timeline. Priced against the build because it displaces other work.

autonomy.name: Watch
autonomy.blurb: Observes and reports. Takes no action.

autonomy.name: Draft
autonomy.blurb: Prepares anything a customer would see; a human sends it. Keeps your records up to date as it goes.

autonomy.name: Approve
autonomy.blurb: Acts on its own, but stops for you above a line you set.

autonomy.name: Operate
autonomy.blurb: Acts within scope, escalates exceptions. Enabled in writing after supervision.
